title: Norman F. Potter | Obituaries | rutlandherald.com
text:
Norman F. Potter BOMOSEEN — Norman Fletcher Potter, 84 of Bomoseen died Monday Morning September 14, 2026 at the Pines in Rutland. He was born on March 31, 1942 in Rutland the son of John M. and Marjorie (McAuley) Potter. Mr. Potter graduated from the Rutland High School in 1961. Following high school, he enlisted in the U.S. Navy serving 4 years on the USS Essex Aircraft Carrier as a jet mechanic prior to his honorable discharge in 1965. He married Saundra Senif on July 28, 1962. Mr. Potter was employed by Hobart Food Equipment until purchasing the agency in 1975 operating it for 35 years until his retirement in 2010. During retirement he often enjoyed stopping by and working with his son at his business, Potter Food equipment. Working side by side his son gave him great joy. His hobbies were "working around the farm" as he would always say. He was a former member of the Loyal Order of Moose and Eagles Club. Survivors include his wife Saundra of Bomoseen, a son Matthew Potter and his wife Karen of Rutland, a sister Shirley Vining of Rutland, 2 grandchildren, Spencer , Dylan. A nephew Wayne Potter of Rutland and several nieces and nephews. He was predeceased by his parents, and 2 brothers Robert Potter and Harold Potter. There will be no calling hours. Burial with Military honors at a later date in the Evergreen Cemetery. Memorial contributions may be made to the Rutland County Humane Society Inc., 765 Stevens Road, Pittsford, Vt. 05763
Norman F. Potter
